title: Y-sort doesn't affect the clones created by Parallax2D's repeat feature
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) HD Graphics 530 (0x00001912) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-30.0.101.1692) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6500 CPU @ 3.20GHz (4 threads) - 15.88 GiB memory

### Issue description

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e234371d-156d-49aa-baf4-a5ff884c08ec)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/96602b45-47cc-4c33-816b-7b41bddf4591)

**the 2 lower sprites are clones created by parralax2d**
Clones created by parallax2D have the same Z-index as the originals , despite being lower on the screen and being Y-sorted.
If it worked you would see some purple in the 2nd image, since the blue part is 50% transparent

### Steps to reproduce

**just open the mrp, you'll understand immediatly if you move the sprites around**

1. 2D view
2. root node with Y-sort enabled
3. Parallax2D 5. insert 2 sprites with transparency in the top half, as children of Parallax2D
4. set some value in the repeat size.y parameter of parralax2D
5. move one of the sprites a bit over but overlapping one of the clones that Parallax2D created, but keeping the sprite higher on the screen than the clone.
6. You'll see that the clone is underneat the sprite despite being lower on the screen, which normally when y-sort is enabled it would be OVER it



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Parallax Testing.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23700090/Parallax.Testing.zip)
